name: @cyberluke/railgun
description: State of the art. The fastest native TypeScript toolchain that exists: Go-native TS7 tsc (8-12x vs TS6) + tsgolint (20-40x vs ESLint) — one process, one traversal, no spray. 776-file workspace, type-aware, in ~6000ms. Q3A scoreboard: PERFECT=0 errors, HEADSHOT=1, IMPRESSIVE=2-9, EXCELLENT=10-49. Example: '0 errors | 42 files | 2100 LoC | 18ms | cache: hot' = PERFECT. One command replaces tsc+eslint+oxlint+next lint loops; persistent named-pipe daemon keeps the Go TS program warm. Ships 5 native bodies + railgunize migrator (48 manifests, turbo.json merge, AGENTS.md block, customized SKILL.md, baseline capture).
